entries.description: Unrestricted open-domain natural-language understanding and generation remain outside the currently verified controlled and research-expanded coverage subsets.
entries.workaround: Use declared controlled grammar/realization profiles and surface UNKNOWN or unsupported coverage rather than inventing semantics.

entries.description: Vietnamese support is verified for the declared language-pack subset but not as complete coverage of unrestricted Vietnamese grammar and pragmatics.
entries.workaround: Constrain requests to the language-pack feature manifest and preserve unknown or unsupported constructions without forced normalization.

entries.description: Program repair is bounded to registered repair families and explicit compile/test budgets; arbitrary whole-program autonomous repair is not a verified capability.
entries.workaround: Return a structured partial/failure result when no registered repair candidate satisfies compile, test, regression, and budget constraints.

entries.description: Universal Expression program realization is verified for the declared PIR/backend subsets rather than every programming-language feature or backend.
entries.workaround: Use capability discovery and backend completeness matrices; reject unsupported lowering instead of emitting guessed source.

entries.description: The real in-tree solver adapter proves only its declared bounded propositional Boolean fragment; unsupported theories return UNKNOWN and timeouts remain TIMEOUT.
entries.workaround: Use an externally registered compatible solver for richer theories while preserving SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN/TIMEOUT evidence boundaries.

entries.description: Sign-language, gesture, visual-scene, and broader multimodal semantic grounding are explicitly future-research items and are not current native-core capabilities.
entries.workaround: Represent externally supplied multimodal facts only through declared structured adapters and do not claim native multimodal understanding.
